title: AAT Architecten header
description: A bare white header: wordmark with a hairline and descriptor at the left and, from 1024px, a few grey links spaced wide apart (the last with a small arrow) that darken to ink over 0.6s on hover. It lies over the hero on desktop. On phones the links fold into a grey 'Menu' word that stays fixed at the top-right while the page scrolls and opens a full-window white menu of large grey links.
notes: from 1024px it is absolutely positioned over the first section (the hero leaves room for it); below 1024px it takes its own 104px row
the phone 'Menu' trigger is position: fixed, so it floats over every section in muted grey
the links share the footer's column rhythm: they start 27% into the content width
